§6Electronium§f

§aThe last ingot-form material. Pure electrons, forged from dineutronium.§f

§bElectronium§f is the final material with an ingot form in NTM. It stores energy at near-infinite density, made entirely of electrons.

§6Crafting§f (Book of Boxcars):
§e2 Dineutronium Ingots§f (bottom slots) + §e2 Ionized Particles§f (top slots) → §e1 Electronium Ingot§f

The Book of Boxcars is found in meteor dungeon safes or crafted from 8 black book pages and a balefire egg. Its GUI has a §e2×2§f crafting grid that lights up red when a valid recipe is placed.

§6Uses§f:
§b• FEnSU§f, unlimited energy storage, needs §e64 electronium ingots§f plus other rare materials
§b• Digamma Laser Crystal§f, for digamma-based laser equipment

§ePS:§f Stockpile ionized particles from your fusion reactor before attempting electronium production. Each FEnSU demands a huge amount of ingots, and ionized particles are the usual bottleneck.
